sources.entry: SnippetCraft - System-wide text expansion, snippet management, and clipboard history for macOS.

summary.name: SnippetCraft
summary.one_liner: SnippetCraft is a native Mac text expander and snippet manager that expands triggers system-wide and stores reusable templates, code snippets, and clipboard history.
use_cases: Insert email replies and canned support responses
Save and search frequently used code and git commands
Build templates with fill-in fields like names and dates
Keep clipboard history and turn entries into snippets
Store runbooks and release checklists with Markdown notes
summary.what_it_does: SnippetCraft expands typed triggers such as :reply or :date into saved text in any Mac application, using Accessibility permission. Snippets can include text, date, time, date-time, or clipboard variables and fill-in fields like {{name}} with default values. Users organize snippets with folders, tags, and Markdown documentation, and can preview notes before inserting. A global search palette (⌥⇧F) finds snippets by name, description, or tag, and a clipboard history records copied items that can be filtered by source app and saved as snippets. The page also describes import and export of the full library as a .snippets file, and optional account-based sync across Macs.
notable: Local-first: works without an account; clipboard history processed locally
Dynamic variables and fill-in fields in snippets
Import/export of full library as .snippets file
caveats: Accessibility permission is needed for system-wide expansion
Cloud sync requires signing in and is optional
